description: Source code for the admin controller class 'Category' in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. Handles CRUD operations, listing, filtering, status toggling, and other administrative functions for category management within the catalog module.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing product categories in the OpenCart admin interface. Extends the core Controller class and provides methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting, enabling/disabling, repairing, and autocompleting categories.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point; loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb data, loads sub-controller for category list, and renders the main category page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the category list view by calling getList via sub-controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares paginated, filtered list of categories including images, sorting links, and pagination. Renders the category list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Shows the category creation/edit form, loads existing data if editing, manages images, SEO URLs, layouts, and related data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating category data via POST; performs validation, checks permissions, handles SEO URLs, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Bulk enables selected categories, requires permission, returns JSON with success/error message.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Bulk disables selected categories, operates similar to enable method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected categories after permission check, returns operation status as JSON.

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Repairs category hierarchy, called when fixing category tree structure.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides category name autocomplete suggestions based on filter_name for AJAX search.
